title: FaulT-Bench: Towards Benchmarking Network Troubleshooting LLM Agents under Unreliable User Tickets
abstract: arXiv:2608.27021v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly proposed for network fault diagnosis, but existing benchmarks evaluate them only on accurate tickets and always assume a fault is present, conditions rarely met in practice. We present FaulT-Bench, a benchmark of 200 troubleshooting scenarios across eight network topologies, five reimplemented from public practitioner labs, spanning genuine faults, false fault reports, incorrect device attribution, and incorrect root-cause claims. To isolate how ticket wording affects diagnosis, we further rewrite 72 false-premise tickets into five reporter personas that vary reporter confidence and verifiable detail one factor at a time, holding the network state fixed. Our automated harness deploys each scenario in Kathar\'a, lets agents interact through the NIKA tool interface, and scores free-text diagnoses with an LLM judge across outcome, fix, and reasoning quality. translated_title: FaulT-Bench：面向不可靠用户工单的网络故障排查LLM代理基准测试
translated_abstract: 基于LLM的代理越来越多地被用于网络故障诊断，但现有基准仅基于准确工单且假设故障必然存在进行评估，这些条件在实践中很少满足。我们提出了FaulT-Bench，一个包含200个故障排查场景的基准，涵盖八种网络拓扑，其中五种从公开实践实验室重新实现，涉及真实故障、误报故障、错误设备归因和错误根因声明。为了隔离工单措辞对诊断的影响，我们将72个错误前提工单改写成五种报告人角色，这些角色每次只改变报告人的置信度和可验证细节一个因素，同时保持网络状态固定。我们的自动化测试平台在Kathar\'a中部署每个场景，让代理通过NIKA工具界面交互，并使用LLM评审器对自由文本诊断在结果、修复和推理质量方面进行评分。评估SADE、ReAct和Claude Code，我们发现了……
tldr: 本文提出了FaulT-Bench，一个首个针对不可靠用户工单的网络故障排查LLM代理基准，通过多样化场景和角色变体系统评估代理在真实条件下的诊断能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FaulT-Bench, the first benchmark for network troubleshooting LLM agents under unreliable user tickets, systematically evaluating agent diagnostic capability through diverse scenarios and persona variations in realistic conditions.
